nina: Quick heads-up — bringing Nyx-8B (imported from Llama export) into the pipeline. smoke int4 run shows a drop on QA summarization + reproducible longctx drift.
nina: baseline fp16 Rouge-L 39.0 -> int4 35.2, and some examples fail only when input contains multiple ZWJ/combining marks.
arjun: did you compare the vocab ordering between exported tokenizer and our target format? sometimes exporter collapses explicit ZWJ tokens into composed forms.
derek: ran token-diff: ~0.18% tokens mismatched; concentrated in unicode ranges 0x200C-0x200D (ZWJ/ZWNJ) and combining accents. sample: `u"fi\u200dancé"` maps to tokens [112, 4209, 77] in orig, but [112, 4210, 77] in converted.
nina: interesting — also found a per-head permutation in attention weights after conversion. suspect: head-dim layout changed (NCHW vs NHWC-style reshape), but rotary params were kept in original ordering -> headwise rotary/headindex mismatch.
arjun: that would explain longctx: if kvcache stores heads in permuted order but rotary is applied assuming original order, alignment degrades after warmup. do you have a quick repro?
derek: minimal repro:
```python
# load two checkpoints and compare headwise rotary pairing
from pathlib import Path
import torch
a = torch.load('nyx_orig.pt', map_location='cpu')
b = torch.load('nyx_converted.pt', map_location='cpu')
# compare head 0 weight slice vs head mapping
print((a['attn.qkv.weight'][:64]==b['attn.qkv.weight'][:64]).float().mean())
print('rotary_orig[:8]', a['rotary.freq'][:8])
print('rotary_conv[:8]', b['rotary.freq'][:8])
```
arjun: two mitigation routes: (1) reorder q/k/v heads to match original head indices then reserialize, (2) apply head-permutation metadata and adapt kvcache indexing at runtime (safer for a stopgap).

ops-bot: dev-cluster: snapshot queued nyx-conv-int4-remap-20260323 (req: rq_9c2b). ETA ~30m.
arjun: for immediate A/B, I can script a remap that permutes rotary arrays to match converted ordering and also run embed-id remap for the ZWJ block. prefer to test rotary-permute only first to isolate vocab vs rotary contribution.
derek: I'll run two experiments tonight on dev: (A) embed-id remap only + int4-reserialize, (B) rotary-permute only + int4-reserialize. we'll compare Rouge-L and a targeted longctx factual recall test.
nina: thanks. can you also dump the first 500 token mappings with `scripts/show_token_deltas.py --ranges 0x200-0x360`? helps confirm contiguous block shifts.
arjun: note: if tokenizer normalizer differs (NFKC vs NFC), remapping might be incomplete; cleaner long-term fix is to preserve original tokenizer normalizer during conversion and re-run serialization. but that will require touching tokenizers repo and a small RFC.
ci-bot: evals: small-run queued: summarization-longctx and factual-qa-long (run id: ev_3321).
derek: adding logs here once done. short-term goal: determine if >50% of Rouge-L drop attributable to vocab mismap or rotary misorder. if neither, escalate to quant kernel check (per-head quant scaling bug).
nina: great plan. tagging @arjun @derek. will follow up with outputs. :mag_right:
